title: Function of human SIRPa low and SIRPa high macrophages in Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection
description: to induce and sort human SIRPa low and SIRPa high macrophages from PBMCs, and then cultured them under tuberculosis challengement. And then determine their global transcripts differences between the SIRPa low and SIRPa high group.

samples.title: Human sample from Homo sapiens
attributes: eight medical center of PLA general hospital

PBMCs from healthy volunteer one were cultured for 7 days and induced to CD14+ macrophages, then the cells were sorted to be SIRPa high and cultured again, then were challenged with H37Rv for 24 hours.

runs.experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: RNA seq of human: Adult female blood
